before.evidence:

The two studies are being reported together.  
Faint linear intrasubstance fluid hyperintensity is noted at the posterior horns of both menisci, in keeping with age-related persistent vascularity.  
Otherwise intact menisci, cruciate and collateral ligaments, popliteus musculotendinous units, extensor tendons and both distal iliotibial bands.  
No skeletal abnormalities of note. 
No patellofemoral dysplasia morphology demonstrated on either side.  
Well-maintained tricompartmental articular cartilage surfaces are appreciated bilaterally, with no osteochondral lesions being demonstrated.  
No knee joint effusions are present on either side, nor are there any intra-articular loose bodies. 
No anterior fat pad impingement has been demonstrated either.  
Grossly unremarkable imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

Normal.
